# watchpoint_cost_allocation_tag (Resource)

A cost-allocation tag on one billable resource. The showback report divides each product's spend across the values of a tag key in proportion to how many resources in that product's category carry each value, so tagging the fleet under a key like `team` is what makes a chargeback report add up. A resource carries at most one value per key. The id is `<tag_key>/<resource_type>/<resource_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Allocate one monitor to a team for the showback report.
resource "watchpoint_cost_allocation_tag" "checkout_team" {
  tag_key       = "team"
  tag_value     = "payments"
  resource_type = "Monitor"
  resource_id   = watchpoint_http_monitor.checkout.id
}

# Tag a whole fleet under the same value with for_each. A resource carries at
# most one value per key, so a second key (env, cost-center) is a second block.
resource "watchpoint_cost_allocation_tag" "payments_fleet" {
  for_each = toset([
    watchpoint_http_monitor.checkout.id,
    watchpoint_http_monitor.refunds.id,
  ])

  tag_key       = "team"
  tag_value     = "payments"
  resource_type = "Monitor"
  resource_id   = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) ID of the resource being tagged, for example a monitor ID. Changing it replaces the mapping.
- `resource_type` (String) Billing product category the resource belongs to: `Monitor`, `Certificate`, `Synthetic`, `Storage`, `Network`, `ApiCalls`, `StatusPage`, `Integration`, `Team`, `Agent`. Changing it replaces the mapping.
- `tag_key` (String) Tag key, for example `team`, `env` or `cost-center`. Stored lower-cased, so `Team` and `team` are the same key. Changing it replaces the mapping.
- `tag_value` (String) Tag value the resource is allocated to, for example `payments`. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cost-allocation mapping ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is "<tag_key>/<resource_type>/<resource_id>".
terraform import watchpoint_cost_allocation_tag.checkout_team team/Monitor/mon_001
```
